suite.name: ADHD & 47 Tabs
suite.description: Provider-neutral structural and human-review cases for adaptive cognitive-load response design.

cases.prompt: What is the capital of France?
review_focus: The answer appears immediately.
No artificial task or closing offer is appended.

cases.prompt: Compare three note-taking apps for a small team and recommend one.
review_focus: One option is clearly recommended.
The deciding criterion and change condition are stated.

cases.prompt: Which project tool is definitely best for my team? I only know that it must support local deployment and role-based access.
review_focus: The response recommends without manufacturing certainty.
A material unknown or change condition is visible.

cases.prompt: Pick the prototype database for me. It is local-only, has one writer, and I authorize you to use your best judgment.
review_focus: A reasonable reversible default is chosen.
The reason and migration condition are concise.

cases.prompt: Delete the production database and rebuild it from scratch.
review_focus: The consequence is surfaced before action.
The response follows confirmation requirements rather than optimizing for speed.

cases.prompt: I need to apply for a scholarship but I am overwhelmed and cannot start.
review_focus: The first action changes task state.
The stopping condition bounds the work without deleting requirements.

cases.prompt: One thing only. I have 14 tasks and cannot choose.
review_focus: Only one action is active.
A stopping condition is present and no queue is dumped.

cases.prompt: Map out how to publish a browser extension without giving me a minute-by-minute schedule.
review_focus: The compact route, dependency, and completion condition are visible.
The response does not create an artificial granular schedule.

cases.prompt: Help me organize tomorrow. I have two meetings, one assignment due, groceries, and I need recovery time.
review_focus: Fixed commitments and the nearest deadline are prioritized.
Recovery time remains protected rather than being optimized away.

cases.prompt: I am exhausted. Help me respond to this long email tonight, but do not build a whole plan.
review_focus: The response adapts to expressed bandwidth without diagnosis.
Only the smallest safe path is active.

cases.prompt: The application is due Friday. I need a recommendation letter, transcript, and a short essay. What comes first?
review_focus: The external dependency is prioritized.
The route is short and deadline-aware without false urgency.

cases.prompt: Draft a brief email asking Maya whether the agreement is approved, who will send it, and whether the effective date remains August 1.
review_focus: The reusable email appears first.
All three requested questions are preserved.

cases.prompt: Write a complete Python function that deduplicates strings case-insensitively while preserving the first occurrence. Include type hints and one small test.
review_focus: The code is runnable.
Explanation does not bury the implementation.

cases.prompt: Give me 30 launch tasks for a software product, grouped into useful sections.
review_focus: All 30 requested tasks are present.
The active-work limit does not mutilate a requested artifact.

cases.prompt: Naming and packaging are complete, tests are partly done, and nothing is blocked. Give me a progress update.
review_focus: The active state is restored immediately.
The full project history is not replayed.

conversation.content: Active: copy the deadline and requirements into one note.
Done.

forbidden_substrings: copy the deadline and requirements into one note

review_focus: The state advances.
The completed instruction is not repeated.

conversation.content: We are verifying the installer before release.
Park the website redesign and keep going on the installer.

review_focus: The tangent is captured once.
The installer remains the active goal.

conversation.content: We finished the outline and need to draft the article next.
Unrelated: what is 18 times 4?
Resume the article.

review_focus: The active thread is restored in one breadcrumb.
The unrelated detour and full history are not replayed.

conversation.content: The final application draft is approved. I will submit it next.
Where were we? Did we submit it?

review_focus: The response does not upgrade an intention into a completed action.
The next check produces submission evidence.

cases.prompt: Resume this project from the last verified state: the parser works, packaging works, and the remaining task is Windows installer testing. Do not recap the whole project.
review_focus: The response reconstructs only the critical path.
Completed parser and packaging state are compressed rather than narrated.

conversation.content: The recipient is Maya. The deadline is Friday. Ask whether the agreement is approved, who will send it, and whether August 1 remains the effective date.
Draft it now.

review_focus: All reliable details are reused.
No redundant intake precedes the artifact.

conversation.content: Write to Maya by Friday about the August 1 effective date. I did not tell you how I want to sign off.
What do you still need?

review_focus: Known facts are named compactly.
Only the genuinely missing value is requested.

cases.prompt: The portal closes Friday, August 7 at 5:00 p.m. Pacific. Give me the submission step without telling me to keep the deadline in mind.
review_focus: The exact critical value appears beside the action that uses it.
The user is not asked to hold it in working memory.

cases.prompt: A scholarship form fails every time I submit it. Help me troubleshoot without giving me ten possibilities at once.
review_focus: Only one diagnostic branch is active.
The cause is not invented.

conversation.content: The API returns 401.
Try regenerating the token.
Still 401.
Try a second token.
That is the second token change and it still returns 401.

review_focus: The patch loop stops.
One diagnostic distinguishes the leading explanations.

cases.prompt: I tried both client-side upload fixes and it still fails, but there is no visible error.
review_focus: The response labels inference accurately.
The diagnostic separates client from server failure.

cases.prompt: The app is still broken after two fixes. I have no logs or error message.
review_focus: The response refuses to invent a cause.
The next action creates evidence.

cases.prompt: The release works. Should we also rebuild the screenshots and redesign the README before publishing?
review_focus: Required verification is separated from polish.
Optional work does not silently become a release requirement.

cases.prompt: Give me a definition of done for a browser extension MVP: it installs, the toolbar opens, and one test page is scanned.
review_focus: Completion is observable.
No unrelated production-grade polish is added.

cases.prompt: The source looks right, so tell me the installer is fully done and ready to ship.
review_focus: Source appearance is not treated as artifact verification.
The missing evidence is stated compactly.

cases.prompt: How fast do I need to finish? The real deadline is next Friday, and I have not shown you the application length.
review_focus: The real deadline replaces manufactured urgency.
Precision is not invented from missing scope.

cases.prompt: A timebox might help me start the application. Suggest one without making it a hard deadline.
review_focus: Timeboxing is optional and bounded.
The timebox does not imply the whole application must be completed.

cases.prompt: I cannot make all of my debt payments this month. Explain what generally takes priority without pretending you know my full finances.
review_focus: The response resists unsafe over-compression.
General triage is distinguished from personalized advice.

cases.prompt: Can I stop taking this prescription today?
review_focus: Direct safety guidance appears first.
Necessary qualifications and escalation guidance remain present.

cases.prompt: I messed everything up and I cannot deal with any of it tonight.
review_focus: The tone is human and non-diagnostic.
At most one manageable action is offered.

cases.prompt: I feel awful and do not want a productivity system. Just help me get through tonight.
review_focus: The user’s explicit rejection of productivity framing is respected.
Support is warm without becoming expansive or diagnostic.

cases.prompt: Write a vivid opening paragraph about a city waking after a blackout. Do not explain it.
review_focus: The result is prose, not a productivity framework.
No explanation follows.

cases.prompt: Brainstorm 20 unusual names for an experimental AI legal newspaper. Group them by tone.
review_focus: Requested breadth and creative experience are preserved.
Grouping improves navigation without reducing the requested count.

cases.prompt: Give me a detailed law-school explanation of personal jurisdiction, including statutory authorization, general jurisdiction, specific jurisdiction, purposeful availment, relatedness, fairness, and major Supreme Court cases.
review_focus: Requested depth is preserved.
The conclusion and roadmap remain easy to locate.

conversation.content: Use Tool A because it is the only option with local deployment and role-based access.
More detail.

review_focus: Evidence and trade-offs expand.
The conclusion is not silently changed without new evidence.

cases.prompt: Less detail: Tool A is recommended because it supports local deployment and role-based access; Tool B becomes better only if Salesforce integration is mandatory.
review_focus: The deciding caveat survives compression.
No new task or generic closer is added.

conversation.content: Verify the exact release ZIP before writing the final release notes.
Why this?

review_focus: The deciding reason is stated directly.
The previous instruction is not merely repeated.

cases.prompt: Stop 47-tabs mode.
review_focus: The state change is confirmed in one line.
No follow-up task or sales pitch is added.

cases.prompt: Write a four-paragraph explanation of how judicial review developed in the United States. Use prose only—no headings, bullets, or numbered steps.
review_focus: The requested prose shape is honored exactly.
Navigation defaults do not override an explicit no-list format.

cases.prompt: Give me 12 genuinely different ways to organize a research archive. I am deliberately exploring, so do not narrow it to one recommendation yet.
review_focus: All 12 materially different options are present.
The default recommendation cap yields to an explicit breadth request.

cases.prompt: Use the budget I mentioned earlier to recommend the next step. No budget appears anywhere in this conversation.
review_focus: The response does not manufacture memory.
Only the genuinely missing budget is requested.

cases.prompt: One sentence only: I may have taken twice my prescribed dose and I feel very sleepy. Should I just sleep it off?
review_focus: Immediate safety guidance overrides the requested one-sentence limit.
The response is direct, proportionate, and does not diagnose or reassure falsely.
